name: horizon-pulse
description: Horizon Pulse for agents: `npx horizon-pulse setup` registers the hosted MCP server (horizonpulse.dev/mcp) with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and Windsurf and installs the skill (diff preview, backups, asks first). Also a local stdio MCP server that pays x402 (USDC on Base) from a buyer wallet you configure, with per-call and per-session spend caps.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/setup.test.mjs && node test/unpaid-test.mjs
